case-studies.title: WP4 – Case Studies evaluation
case-studies.description: Approved Case Studies questionnaire for Business/SME staff. The number of tested Case Studies is filled in automatically.

scenarios.title: WP4 – Scenarios evaluation
scenarios.description: Approved Scenarios questionnaire for educators and learners.

caseStudies.q1: How many Case studies did you test?
caseStudies.engagementEase: How easy was it for you to engage with the Case studies during this activity? Please choose the option that best describes your views.
caseStudies.greenTransitionUnderstanding: In your experience, how effective was the case studies in increasing your understanding of the meaning of green transition? Please choose the option that best describes your views.
caseStudies.esgEcosystemUnderstanding: In your experience, how effective was the case studies in increasing your understanding of ESG as a process within the wider ecosystem of business, society and environment? Please choose the option that best describes your views.
caseStudies.skills: Which Key Transversal Skills did you enhance while using the Case studies? Please select one or more than one of the options below.
caseStudies.challenges: What challenges, if any, did you face during the use of the Case studies?
caseStudies.improvements: What improvements, if any, would you suggest?

scenarios.incorporationEase: How easy do you think it would be for you to incorporate the Scenarios into your existing work activities? Please choose the option that best describes your views.
scenarios.participantEngagement: In your experience, how effective can the scenarios be in engaging participants and helping them understand the of ESG as a process within the wider ecosystem of business, society and environment? Please choose the option that best describes your views.
scenarios.skills: In which of the following areas could these Scenarios be most helpful for educators? Please select one or more options below.
scenarios.challenges: What challenges, if any, did you face during the use of the Scenarios?
scenarios.implementationChallenges: Which challenges, if any, do you foresee during their implementation into your existing work activities?
scenarios.improvements: What improvements, if any, would you suggest enhancing its usability in future sessions?
